scope: Finite target schema preflight, packaged through-migration cap, CLI, product-only restore gate, extracted auth/settings/scan DDL and associated static test oracles. Existing backup/supervision/namespace producers read only as directly necessary contract references.

prior_finding_disposition.basis: Whole-profile preflight is now invoked only for product_data=True and still precedes target creation. Dedicated arbitrary-only archival test preserves exact marker/source bytes, DATABASES_ONLY/PENDING/inhibited/disconnected profile, absence of migration table, and actual normal canonical writer refusal without mutation.
Only the migrator-produced supported prefix, or that exact schema plus existing immutable namespace owner DDL, is accepted; no source SQL or namespace row is executed/seeded.

static_evidence.conclusion: Present/absent roles must be unique, disjoint and exactly close the fixed inventory; canonical must be present. Each present artifact has the canonical direct-child filename and exact configured relative path before private protected inspection.

Target schema models are isolated in-memory SQLite schemas built from fixed packaged DDL. Canonical history must be a recognized packaged prefix at least 0019; the cap is exact packaged-name-only and cannot precede applied history or accept custom scripts. Actual source databases are not opened through migrating owners.

Sealed artifacts are privately checked and hashed before and after mode=ro/immutable/query_only structural inspection. Shared deadline/progress handlers cover reads and model generation. Public entry holds all existing PROCESS_ROLES scope locks, verifies the same product manifest before/after and rechecks current config.

Extracted auth/settings/scan DDL constants are the same constants executed by normal constructors and consumed by the model builder. Preflight does not instantiate those writers, enroll users, create sessions or seed settings/scan rows.

Standalone preflight and complete product restore use the strict gate. CLI reports finite blocked reasons and zero database/owner effects; successful facts are scoped COMPATIBLE_FOR_INHIBITED_CLONE with financial_authority NONE. DB-only archival restore retains its prior separate inhibited contract.

limits: No tests, compilation, imports, DB, Git, process, provider or network operations performed by reviewer, and no tracked/source files changed. Only this new outside-Git review artifact is written.
Root-reported development executions are context only. No result of active green03 is inferred.

The compatibility result is bounded schema/layout suitability for an inhibited clone, not arbitrary historical SQL checksum proof, full logical-data validation, concurrent multi-version migration proof or current financial authority.
No all-present eight-role, CLI/native/full profile, PLAT08 row, H01, PQR or Master acceptance/completion claim.
